Reason for Mistake: The Planner mishandled conflicting birth-year data for James Tinling by arbitrarily prioritizing IMDb over Wikipedia (“film-specific source priority”) and introducing an unnecessary “age at release” computation. This reflects premature resolution of ambiguity without proper reconciliation or further verification from additional authoritative sources.
